# Cncf Oracle Functions Reviewer

Review Oracle Functions using its official documentation and repository in the Serverless / Hosted Platform category. Write, deploy, and run code without having to provision, manage, or scale servers. Oracle Functions is a fully managed, highly scalable, on-demand, functions-as-a-service platform, built on enterprise-grade Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and powered by the Fn Project open source engine.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
